steps.code:
# Parse the old songs list from the file content.
content = file_resp['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
# Skip the first line "# Archived Songs"
old_songs = []
for line in lines[1:]:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " to get title and artist(s)
        if ' by ' in line:
            title, artist = line.split(' by ', 1)
            old_songs.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artist': artist.strip()})
print(old_songs)

steps.code:
# Get all playlists, handling pagination. Let's start with page 0, limit 20.
spotify_token = login_resp['access_token']
playlists = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not resp:
        break
    playlists.extend(resp)
    if len(resp) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(f"Total playlists: {len(playlists)}")
for p in playlists:
    print(p['playlist_id'], p['title'], p['song_ids'])

# Let's find which song_ids match the old_songs
# Build a set of old_song titles and artist sets for matching
old_song_titles = set()
old_song_artists = {}  # title -> set of artist names
for s in old_songs:
    title = s['title']
    artist_str = s['artist']
    artist_set = set([a.strip() for a in artist_str.split(',')])
    old_song_titles.add(title)
    old_song_artists[title] = artist_set

# Now iterate over song_details to find matches
matching_song_ids = set()
for song_id, details in song_details.items():
    title = details['title']
    if title not in old_song_titles:
        continue
    # Get artist names from details
    detail_artists = set([a['name'] for a in details['artists']])
    # Compare with old_song_artists[title]
    if detail_artists == old_song_artists[title]:
        matching_song_ids.add(song_id)

print("Matching song IDs:", matching_song_ids)
print("Count:", len(matching_song_ids))
